findings.summary: Joe Gebbia (Airbnb co-founder) holds concurrent positions creating conflict of interest: Tesla board member (audit committee), US Chief Design Officer (WH appointment reporting to CoS Susie Wiles), and prior DOGE role at OPM. LittleSis confirms: position at DOGE, position as CDO at National Design Studio, board member at Tesla Inc, and personal friendship with Elon Musk. FEC records show his political donations shifted dramatically from Democrats (Biden Victory Fund, Hillary Clinton, multiple state Democratic parties) to Republicans (MAHA Alliance, Kennedy Victory Fund, Wonder Women PAC, Mike Johnson) starting 2024.

Joe Gebbia made a massive ,900 donation to Kennedy Victory Fund 2024 on Nov 22, 2024, plus ,300 to Libertarian National Committee, ,099 to LP of Connecticut, ,000 to Montana LP, ,300 to Team Kennedy, and ,000 to LP of Hawaii (Dec 4, 2024). Listed as 'Founder, Samara' from Redwood City, CA. By 2025, switched employer to 'US Government/Chief Design Officer' and donated to Republican causes: Wonder Women PAC (,500), Tuberville for Senate (,300), American Revival PAC (,333), Mike Johnson (,333), Grow the Majority (,000).

Gebbia continues massive Airbnb stock sales while serving as Tesla board member and federal CDO. SEC Form 4 filings (CIK 0001834171) show 133 insider filings. In the most recent period alone: Feb 23, 2026 sold ~58,000 ABNB shares at -128 (~.1M), Feb 9 sold ~58,000 shares at -122 (~M), Jan 26 sold ~58,000 at -134 (~.7M), Jan 12 sold ~58,000 at -140 (~M). Retains only 2,860 shares. This systematic liquidation while holding government and Tesla positions raises questions about whether government service provides advance market intelligence.

LittleSis relationship mapping reveals Gebbia's network spans tech, politics, and government: personal friendship with Elon Musk, board seat at Tesla Inc, DOGE position, CDO at National Design Studio, and extensive political giving. His pre-2024 donations were overwhelmingly Democratic (Biden Victory Fund, Hillary Clinton, Chuck Schumer, Bill de Blasio, multiple state Democratic parties, Equality PAC). The pivot to Kennedy/Libertarian/Republican in late 2024 coincides with his path into DOGE and the Trump administration. Previous employer listed as 'Samara' (his design/venture firm), now self-identifies as 'US Government/Chief Design Officer' on FEC filings.

DOGE operative: Joe Gebbia — Airbnb co-founder, Tesla board member, assigned to OPM. Dual conflict: (1) Tesla board member accessing federal workforce systems while Tesla depends on government contracts/regulation; (2) Airbnb co-founder at OPM while Airbnb faces regulatory issues. FEC: active Republican donor from Austin TX — 1K to WinRed (Dec 2025), 1.5K to Wonder Women PAC, 250 to RNC, 2.5K to WinRed (Aug 2025).
Post-DOGE: Airbnb co-founder appointed Chief Design Officer, National Design Studio created
findings.detail: In August 2025, Trump appointed Joe Gebbia (Airbnb co-founder, DOGE associate) as first US Chief Design Officer. Executive order established National Design Studio within White House Office for 3-year term. Focus: redesign 26,000 federal web portals, starting with 10 most-visited government websites. Edward Coristine ('Big Balls') appears to work for the design group after leaving SSA. This represents a continuation of DOGE's tech presence under a different organizational name and mandate. Gebbia's directive: make government services 'as satisfying to use as the Apple Store.'

findings.summary: Tesla board member and Airbnb co-founder appointed first US Chief Design Officer; systematic Airbnb stock liquidation during government service
findings.detail: Joe Gebbia, Airbnb co-founder and Tesla board member (Class III director, Audit Committee member since 2022), appointed first US Chief Design Officer in August 2025, leading National Design Studio ('America by Design' initiative). SEC Form 4 filings (CIK 0001834171) show 133 insider filings with systematic ABNB stock liquidation: Feb 23, 2026 sold ~58,000 shares at $124-128 (~$7.1M), Feb 9 sold ~58,000 at $119-122 (~$7M), Jan 26 sold ~58,000 at $130-134 (~$7.7M), Jan 12 sold ~58,000 at $137-140 (~$8M). Retained only 2,860 shares. Total recent liquidation exceeds $30M. FEC shows dramatic political donor shift: pre-2024 overwhelmingly Democratic (Biden Victory Fund, Hillary Clinton), pivoted to Kennedy Victory Fund ($6,900), Libertarian committees ($6,399), then Republican causes (Wonder Women PAC $1,500, Tuberville $1,300). 3-year term as CDO.
